entities.summary: Pigs, a notable figure in the history of Cuba, associated with The Cuban Revolution and Cold War Confrontation (1960–1963). Preceded by Castro declares Cuba a socialist state aligned with the Soviet Union and Granma landing and start of guerrilla war — December 2, 1956. Their legacy influenced Bay of Pigs invasion defeated — April 17–19, 1961 and Cuban Missile Crisis — October 16–28, 1962.
